# Day Base

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An Obsidian base file with multiple views for a day.

## Scope note

- Provides a Obsidian base views with selected filters, properties, group, sort, formula, and sequence criteria.
- Used for metadata management and workflow processing.
